purpose: Exploratory finite-ensemble joint-profile interaction and conditional decision audit; not external accuracy validation.
samples: All 35 native FRESNO FINE samples; no date selection.
central_controller: Unchanged frozen native reconstruction; sequential converged-fit removal of most negative source.
ensemble_controller: Use each sample's final central retained slots. Cartesian product of listed profiles for present variable slots; all other retained slots fixed. No fresh pruning, nonnegative constraints or clipping in alternative fits.
distance: Number of retained variable slots whose chosen profile differs from its central profile.

screens.converged: Both central and alternative converged, no diagnostic screen.
screens.basic: Both central and alternative converged and have 0.8 <= R2 <= 1 and 0 <= reduced chi-square <= 4.
screens.strict: Basic conditions plus 80 <= percent mass <= 120 for both.

unresolved: Any nonconverged fit or numerical ValueError is unresolved regardless of its terminal diagnostics. It is not assigned an admissibility or ranking outcome and prevents a complete-grid stability certificate.
decisions: Compare family-slot pairwise signs and exact set of top-ranked source families. Ties are retained, not broken. Assess rounding to five decimals separately.
local: All grid choices of distance <= 1. Local resolved stability requires all local choices resolved, at least one passing distance-1 alternative, and no admissible changed decision. Observed local stability with unresolved choices is explicitly weaker.
joint: All enumerated choices. Report witnessed instability and minimum observed witness distance; if smaller distances contain unresolved choices, do not call the minimum exact.
conditional_certificate: Only conditional on this finite grid, fixed central retained source universe, historical species and numerical solver. No coverage probability, confidence interval, causality, truth or out-of-grid guarantee.
public_scope: Aggregate counts, configuration and code only. Full sample/date contribution vectors and witnesses remain in ignored private output.
randomness: none; exhaustive deterministic enumeration; no tuning after outcomes
